## Incident Overview

tests/scripts/test-commit-workflow-step-1-5.sh adds `test_step_1_heading_present` that greps the workflow file for an exact heading regex `^## Step 1: Changed Integration/E2E Test`. Any innocuous heading edit breaks the test.

## Source

CI llm-review iteration 8 finding [14] on PR #37 (job 74100719710). Classified IMPORTANT by reviewer; analysis classified MINOR — heading is a documented contract anchor.

## Suggested Fix

Same pattern: document intent or use structural matcher tolerant of casing/punctuation.
